questions.question: "One who can use either hand with ease" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Ambidextrous' (दोनों हाथों से काम करने में कुशल) means one who can use either hand with ease.

questions.question: A person appointed by two parties to settle a dispute is called:
questions.rationale: 'Arbitrator' (मध्यस्थ / बिचौलिया) is a person appointed by two parties to settle a dispute.

questions.question: "One who leaves his country to settle in another" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Emigrant' (देशत्यागी / प्रवासी) is one who leaves his own country to settle in another; an 'Immigrant' is one who comes into a country to settle.

questions.question: "A husband ruled by his wife" is described as:
questions.rationale: 'Henpecked' (जोरू का गुलाम) describes a husband ruled by his wife.

questions.question: "One who does not believe in God" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Atheist' (नास्तिक) is a person who does not believe in God; an 'Apostate' is one who has changed his faith.

questions.question: "One who collects stamps" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Philatelist' (डाक टिकट संग्रहकर्ता) is one who collects stamps as a hobby.

questions.question: "One recovering from illness" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Convalescent' (स्वास्थ्य-लाभ पाने वाला) refers to one who is recovering from illness; 'Insolvent' means unable to pay debts.

questions.question: "One who runs away from justice" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Fugitive' (भगोड़ा) is one who runs away from justice; an 'Emigrant' simply leaves his country to settle elsewhere.

questions.question: "One who believes in fate" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Fatalist' (भाग्यवादी) is one who believes in fate; a 'Bigot/Fanatic' is filled with excessive religious enthusiasm.

questions.question: "Breaker of images and traditional beliefs" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Iconoclast' (मूर्तिभंजक) is the breaker of images and traditional beliefs; a 'Cannibal' feeds on human flesh.

questions.question: "One who is unable to pay his debts" is called:
questions.rationale: 'Bankrupt / Insolvent' (दिवालिया) is one who is unable to pay his debts; 'Honorary' means holding a post without any salary.
